name: Lock Icon
description: Lock icon with animated variations for password visibility and security states

variations.name: default
variations.description: For password visibility toggles - shackle slides up-right and body slides down-left when password is visible (unlocked state)

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isUnlocked
props.description: Controls the unlocked state animation. Set to true when password is visible, false when hidden.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the shackle/body slide in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far the shackle and body slide apart, in viewBox units

variations.name: unlock
variations.description: For premium content unlock or access granted states - shackle lifts upward and rotates 90° in 3D with right side as hinge, body scales slightly

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isUnlocked
props.description: Controls the unlocked state. Set to true to show the dramatic unlock animation with 3D rotation.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the shackle swing in seconds; lock-back and body pulse scale with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the shackle swing. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
